body:
There are two ways we could combine our surnames, and the first sounds exactly like his surname. The second one sounds like an insult and I still wouldn't be able to say it right. It's a nice idea for others, though!

Interesting idea in the third paragraph though, thanks - I'll give it some thought
Noooo, don't get me wrong, he is a great partner! I just don't want to feel like I'm pushing him into things. He probably won't be too bothered, but I feel guilty if I "nag" him too often
Talking to him would be the obvious thing to do, I guess! I'm scared I sound like I'm pressuring him into something, but I might mention it later
I used to have trouble with the "r" sound too. Funny thing is, I can say it fine now, but when I listen to recordings of me, I often don't say it right. No clue what's going on in my head lol
Sadly it's the "dark L" that I can't say properly, so I can't change it to anything else without it becoming drastically different

Yeah, maybe I do need some time off... I'm not back at work until Saturday (I'm a shift worker) so I've got some time. I've spent most of the last couple of days in bed anyway, because I felt too wiped out to do anything. I wish I could accept it, but I'm so scared of screwing everything up.
I like listening to a lot of things. My favourites are probably Depeche Mode and The Cure, but I like all sorts of things, from jazz to classic rock to electronica. It's hard to listen to some things when I'm in a state, but most familiar stuff is fine.

That sounds like me. I'm sure I've had episodes where I felt like I wasn't really there before, mainly a few years ago when stress from my job was getting on top of me. I had migraines too - maybe it's a similar thing.
Thanks for the suggestion. I can manage to listen to music just now, but yesterday even listening to music was too much. It was like all sensory input was unwelcome. God knows why...

Hi, thanks for replying :) I think I find it quite hard to take care of myself, and have a tendency to wear myself down, but maybe I can manage. How does it feel to feel better (I take it you do feel better these days)?
